_comment: Identical grants to 03, but Data Access logging is turned ON for the two services. Now the reads ARE recorded, so whether they are a blind spot no longer depends on LOGGING — it depends on whether a loaded rule OBSERVES them. This is the Log-vs-Observes contrast.
_expect: blindspots secretmanager.versions.access  ->  now LOGGED. With no rules loaded it is still a gap (nothing observes it). Load the corpus and it depends on whether a secret-access rule exists.
Diff against 03: same reachability, different logging — the reason a gap exists changes from 'unlogged' to 'unobserved'.
name: data-access-on
